reviews.text: I have oily skin and when applying it feels like it absorbs it, giving it a matte look. No white cast, doesn’t peel, doesn’t irritate eyes, it has little fragrance to it but it’s bearable it’s not too strong, it does however feel bit heavy for my liking. But overall pretty good for a sun stick.
reviews.zh: 我係油性皮膚，塗嗰陣感覺佢會吸收油脂，令皮膚睇落啞光。冇白色殘留，唔會搓泥，唔會刺激眼睛。佢有少少香味，但係可以接受，唔會太濃。不過，以我嘅口味嚟講，佢感覺有少少厚身。整體嚟講，作為防曬棒都幾好。

reviews.text: I really love this product! It has a nice texture, feels comfortable on the skin, and absorbs well without leaving any sticky feeling. My skin feels soft, smooth, and hydrated after use. The quality is great, and I’m very happy with my purchase. Definitely recommend!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款產品！質地好好，塗落皮膚好舒服，吸收好，唔會有黏膩感。用完皮膚軟滑、水潤。質素好好，我好滿意今次嘅購買。一定推薦！

reviews.text: I’ve been really enjoying the TOCOBO Cotton Soft Sun Stick! It’s super lightweight, glides on smoothly, and leaves a soft matte finish without feeling greasy. It’s perfect for reapplying sunscreen throughout the day because it doesn’t feel heavy and doesn’t leave a white cast. My skin stays fresh and comfortable, and I love how easy it is to carry around for touch-ups. If you have oily or combination skin, I’d definitely recommend giving this one a try! ☀️✨
reviews.zh: 我一直好享受 TOCOBO Cotton Soft Sun Stick！質地超輕盈，推開好順滑，留低柔和嘅啞光效果，又唔會油膩。好啱日間補擦防曬，因為唔會覺得厚身，亦唔會留白。我嘅皮膚保持清爽舒適，我好鍾意佢易攜帶、方便補擦。如果你係油性或者混合性皮膚，我絕對推薦你試吓呢支！☀️✨

reviews.text: My favorite sun stick. It does protect from the sun, I tested on the beach, not even a light tan on my face and shoulders. Texture is silky and non sticky. I doesn't leave any white cast. it perfect for under make up. I really love it.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅防曬棒。佢真係有防曬效果，我喺海灘試過，面同肩膊連少少曬黑都冇。質地絲滑，唔黏。唔會留白。好啱做底妝。我真係好鍾意。

reviews.text:
This is my first time purchasing this sunscreen and OMG the texture it leaves on your skin 😍😍😍😍 
It also helps to control oily skin giving you a natural and controlled glow
It water resistant so it's a plus 
I'm definitely buying this again
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一次買呢款防曬，我嘅天，佢留喺皮膚上嘅質感 😍😍😍😍 
佢亦有助控制油光，令皮膚有自然、受控嘅光澤
佢防水，所以係加分位
我一定會再買！

reviews.text: Haven’t tried it out much yet but seems to be pretty good so far… I just tested it ok the back of my hand and it’s just how I like my sunsticks… leaving no oily film and is rather dry… especially after putting sunscreen and moisturizer on in the morning the last thing I need 3 hours later is smearing some more oil on my face.
reviews.zh: 我未點用過，但係目前睇落都幾好……我啱啱喺手背上面試咗吓，正正係我鍾意嘅防曬棒嗰種樣……唔會留低油膜，而且相當乾爽……尤其係朝早塗咗防曬同保濕霜之後，3 個鐘頭後最唔需要嘅就係再喺面上塗多啲油。

reviews.text: When I first used it I was sure it was even on because the finish is no oily or wet and very light and soft. I think it would be perfect for my hands and body. On the other hand, it is not for anybody that wants moisturizing sunstick. May be too dry for the face as well.
reviews.zh: 第一次用嗰陣，我好肯定佢塗得好均勻，因為完成效果唔油、唔濕，好輕盈、柔和。我覺得用嚟擦手同身體就最啱。另一方面，佢唔適合想要保濕型防曬棒嘅人。對面部嚟講都可能太乾。

reviews.text: I really wanted to like this. I use sun sticks around my eyes in case I’m using a chemical sunscreen that causes irritation. A few influencers I follow liked the texture and found it to not bother their eyes. The texture is fantastic, not at all like a greasy zinc stick, but my eyes started burning immediately. 😭
reviews.zh: 我真係好想鍾意呢款。我喺眼周擦防曬棒，以防我用嘅化學防曬會刺激到眼睛。我追蹤嘅幾個網紅都話佢質地好好，唔會刺激佢哋嘅眼睛。質地真係好正，完全唔似油膩嘅氧化鋅防曬棒，但係我雙眼即刻開始灼燒。😭

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
